invariants.rationale: It is common for a collection parameter to be non-null before the method executes.
The context parameter is likely required for the operations in the method.
If partitionPaths is not null, its size is always non-negative per List contract.
Partitions paths are likely non-null strings when used as path identifiers.
The context parameter must be an instance of HoodieEngineContext for method calls to succeed.
